findings.issue: "test": "ng test" but angular.json has no test target and no vitest/jsdom devDependencies, so npm test fails with 'no test builder configured'
findings.suggestion: Add the @angular/build:unit-test target and vitest+jsdom (Angular 22 default), or remove the script rather than shipping a broken one

findings.issue: Pure, easily unit-testable helpers (humanize, latestEnglishFlavor, idFromUrl, dexNumber, formatDecimal) have no tests
findings.suggestion: Add Vitest spec covering mr-mime → 'Mr Mime', whitespace collapse, /10 unit conversion, em-dash fallbacks, URL id extraction

findings.issue: Sort comparators implement subtle spec rules (missing values last in both directions, level-then-name default, tie-breaks) with no tests
findings.suggestion: Spec the comparator directly: missing-last ascending and descending, direction flip, Level Up default order

findings.issue: Filter/pagination math and URL round-trip (page clamping, 48-per-page slice, default-param omission, requestedPage flooring at :128) untested
findings.suggestion: Test that ?page=999 clamps to the last page, page=abc/0 → 1, empty filters are omitted from the query string, filter changes reset page

findings.issue: Failed requests are cached permanently (a rejected promise is stored in the cache Map), so a transient API error permanently breaks that resource
findings.suggestion: Delete the cache entry on rejection (e.g. .catch that removes the key), and add a test for the retry-after-failure path

findings.issue: An invalid ?game= value falls back to the highest-order version group in the select while the URL still shows the bogus value — URL/UI divergence
findings.suggestion: Normalize the URL (replace with the resolved default) and test the fallback behavior

findings.issue: Alternate-form exclusion (id > 10_000) and hidden-ability OR-folding across slots are untested one-line invariants
findings.suggestion: Test with an ability having forms above 10000 and a Pokémon with both regular and hidden slots

findings.issue: Every loader error (including network failures) renders the not-found component, conflating 404 with API outages; untested error path
findings.suggestion: Distinguish 404 from transport errors, and test both branches

findings.issue: #moves scroll implemented via effect + setTimeout hack; brittle and untested
findings.suggestion: Use Router fragment/anchor scrolling, or at minimum test that deep links scroll

findings.issue: Move/method grouping and METHOD_ORDER-relative sort (Level Up, Machine, Egg, Tutor, then alphabetical) untested
findings.suggestion: Unit-test the table construction with a fixture mixing known and unknown methods and null power/accuracy

summary: The app ships zero tests and, worse, a broken npm test script with no runner installed despite Angular 22's built-in Vitest setup. The most regression-prone logic — pure helpers, sort comparators, filtering/pagination, URL round-trips, and a promise cache that stores rejections — sits completely unguarded. As soon as the acceptance suite stops being the safety net, this codebase has none.
